items.name: search-input
items.title: Search input
items.description: type=search input (role searchbox) with a clear button, Escape to clear and Enter to search, inside a Field.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Built on Base UI; ornaments are drawn with CSS only. Escape clears a non-empty value and stops propagation so a surrounding Dialog stays open; with an empty value it passes through. Clearing returns focus to the input. `loading` swaps the search glyph for the Spinner in the same cell (no resize). V4 migration: new `loading`, `loadingLabel`, `reserveError`; a `shortcut` prop (V4-129) is not provided because useShortcut is not in the tree yet.
